newsitem.title: UK: Colombia coffee registrations in a few days - FNC.
newsitem.headline: Colombia coffee registrations in a few days - FNC.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers Federation (FNC) said on Wednesday July-August coffee registrations would be opened in the next few days and not today.
Clarifying a statement from Colombian Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo, FNC director for Europe Fernando Casij said the sales would be opened once the normal procedures were completed.
Casij, speaking by telephone from Brussels where he is based, said: "There are certain procedures that had to be followed by the national (coffee) committee.
"When everything is ready, the FNC will officially notify about the sales and this is expected in the next few days," Casij said.
Ocampo said Colombia was opening "unlimited" coffee registrations for July-August, a period in which the country was expected to export 2.5 million 60-kg bags of coffee.

Ocampo, who spoke after a weekly policy meeting of the National Coffee Growers' Federation, stressed that registrations opening on Wednesday morning for the two-month period would be "without restrictions".
